items.title: Lillie Delk Christian Interview, 1961-04-25
items.q: Yeah, Marie Claybrook, she was there, and, and, uh, uh, Nadine Douglas.

ctx.x: In the Panama show. Do you remember any other, uh, performers who, uh, appeared at the Panama while you were there?
Yeah, Marie Claybrook, she was there, and, and, uh, uh, Nadine Douglas. Jimmy White. He, he was, uh, Jimmy White. He was the, uh, producer of the show. Uh-huh.
Well, you said about 27 at Casino. Was it the next year at Panama, would you say?
